Name: The Home Depot Inc
Description: The Home Depot, Inc. (HD) is the leading home improvement retailer in the United States, providing a comprehensive range of tools, construction products, and home improvement services. Headquartered in Cobb County, Georgia, with a strategic location in Atlanta, the company operates over 2,200 stores across North America. Home Depot has positioned itself as a one-stop-shop for both professional contractors and do-it-yourself homeowners, benefiting from a robust supply chain and an expanding e-commerce platform. With a commitment to innovation and customer service, the company is focused on enhancing the home improvement experience, driving sustained growth and shareholder value.
Address: 2455 PACES FERRY ROAD, ATLANTA, GA, UNITED STATES, 30339
